from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    role: str = Field(description="Role such as Appellant, Appellee, Plaintiff")
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    """A legal case identifier."""
    number: str = Field(description="The full case number string")
    instance: str = Field(description="Instance level e.g. First, Second, Retrial")
    court: str = Field(description="Name of the court")

class Outcome(BaseModel):
    """A specific ruling or judgment disposition."""
    action: str = Field(description="Primary ruling action e.g. Dismiss appeal")
    text: str = Field(description="Verbatim text of the disposition")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """A court fee record."""
    type: str = Field(description="Type of fee e.g. Second instance fee")
    amount: str = Field(description="Amount including unit and condition")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who bears the fee")

class MonetaryOrder(BaseModel):
    """A monetary compensation or payment order."""
    payer: str = Field(description="Payer name")
    payee: str = Field(description="Payee name")
    amount: str = Field(description="Payment amount")
    description: str = Field(description="Purpose of payment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for a single judgment document."""
    case_types: list[str] = Field(description="Type of case e.g. Civil, Administrative")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="Parties involved")
    case_numbers: list[CaseNumber] = Field(description="Case numbers")
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = Field(description="Judgment outcomes")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(description="Fee records")
    monetary_orders: list[MonetaryOrder] = Field(description="Monetary orders")
